rationale.traceability: AC1–AC6 all mapped (TC-001–TC-010), every case names its AC, mapping and document agree, test_gaps listed — 3
rationale.coverage-honesty: AC3 and AC6 claimed 'full' on one case each; AC3 is itself a negative behaviour so arguable, AC6 less so — anchor 2
rationale.dedup-by-assertion: smoke test cited only as a testid source, not credited as coverage; nothing else to credit — 3
rationale.prioritization: P0 3 / P1 5 / P2 2, distinct cases, P0 on the core happy paths — 3
rationale.observed-or-unverified: declares 'no live-app probe'; details sourced from spec + smoke test, uncertain ones marked (unverified); generic wording ('삭제 컨트롤') where the label was not known — anchor 2
rationale.acceptable: complete, honest document; the skipped probe is a process finding (probed-app), not a document flaw

how_to_approve: Replace scored_by with your name, change any score or acceptable you disagree with, delete this field if you like. Until scored_by is a person, calibrate ignores this entry.
